verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
YESU ye anjagala,
Bw'atyo bwe yayogera:
Abaana-abato babe,
Be yawa-omukisagwe.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Ayagala nze,ayagala nze,
Ayagala nze;yayogera bw'atyo.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Ayagala nze,ayagala nze,
Ayagala nze;yayogera bw'atyo.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Yesu ankulembera
Gye naagendanga yonna;
Tandekenga-,alintuusa
Mu ggulu nga njaguza.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Ayagala nze,ayagala nze,
Ayagala nze;yayogera bw'atyo.
